verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a full public API/SDK surface (authentication via scoped Bearer keys, agent provisioning, webhooks, triggers, CLI with --json output for scripting) explicitly aimed at driving agents programmatically, including from AI frameworks like CrewAI/LangGraph/AutoGen or custom scripts. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond first-party docs.
